The 1963–64 season was [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid Club de Fútbol]]'s [[List of Real Madrid CF seasons|61st season]] in existence and the club's [[La Liga records and statistics#All-time La Liga table|32nd consecutive season]] in the top flight of Spanish football.

==Summary==
[[Miguel Muñoz]] continued refreshing the squad, which he started last season,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.elmundo.es/elmundodeporte/especiales/2002/02/centenario/1955.html|title=Historia del Real Madrid, 100 años uno a uno|publisher=Diario El Mundo|access-date=7 December 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200620114019/https://www.elmundo.es/elmundodeporte/especiales/2002/02/centenario/1955.html|archive-date=20 June 2020|url-status=live}}</ref> with Araquistáin as goalkeeper, Pachín, Zoco in defense, and forwards, [[Fernando Serena|Serena]] and Grosso, playing along [[Amancio Amaro|Amancio]] as the beginning of a new era in the club.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://deportes.elpais.com/deportes/2014/11/09/actualidad/1415551382_322979.html|publisher=Diario El País|access-date=10 November 2019|title=Amancio convierte a Puskas en suplente|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304200949/http://deportes.elpais.com/deportes/2014/11/09/actualidad/1415551382_322979.html|archive-date=4 March 2016|url-status=live}}</ref>

The team clinched its tenth League title, the fourth in a row. In the [[1963–64 European Cup|European Cup]], the squad reached the [[1964 European Cup Final|Final]] against [[Helenio Herrera]]'s [[Inter Milan|Inter]] losing the trophy by a 1–3 defeat. The Final was the last official match for [[Alfredo Di Stéfano]] for the club{{notetag|Di Stefano played on 10 June 1964 a friendly match in Rouen.}} due to chairman Santiago Bernabéu choosing not to renew his contract and disagreements with head coach Miguel Muñoz over marking Inter' star [[Giacinto Facchetti]].{{notetag| According to Di Stefano:"It happened what I'm afraid, they attack with Jair, pulling Pachín out of the defensive line, and Milani, pulling Santamaría. Isidro was lonely, without mission. Milani moves to the wing, pulling Santamaría out of the line, and Zoco has to go deep to the center abandoning midfield. So, they attack with 2 and we defending with 4. In the midfield they are more players. They got the game".}}<ref>Di Stefano wanted Isidro to cover Corso. Muñoz rejected the idea replied him that Facchetti will find a free way to receive passes from [[Luis Suarez Miramontes|Luis Suarez]]. In the second half of the Final, Di Stefano (from the field) and Muñoz (in the bench) were arguing each other.{{cite web|url=https://elpais.com/deportes/2015/08/02/actualidad/1438530218_149270.html|work=El País|author=Alfredo Relaño|title="El verano que se fue Di Stéfano"|language=Spanish|access-date=18 June 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200612180419/https://elpais.com/deportes/2015/08/02/actualidad/1438530218_149270.html|archive-date=12 June 2020|url-status=live}}</ref> On 24 June 1964 the club broadcast an official statement with Di Stefano out of Real Madrid after 11 seasons, during which he won 8 League titles and 5 European Cups.

In the Copa del Generalísimo, the club reached the quarter-finals where it was defeated by [[Atlético Madrid]]{{notetag|Played without Di Stéfano and Puskás}} in a tie-breaker match following a 3–3 aggregate draw.
